item.title: Comment on Congestion Tolls versus Congestion Pricing by Vulcidian
item.description:
"I wish the tolls were dynamic. Price uncertainty is better than time uncertainty (paying $10 more today is fine if you pay $10 less tomorrow, but you can’t compensate being 30 min late for a flight or meeting by being 30 min early to the next one)."

WOW. That's definitely a top 1% way to look at the problem. MOST plebs would much rather know the price so they can adjust their timing. Lord save us from solutions based on the elite's utility functions!
